title: Wandrd’s Magnetic Camera Straps Are My New Favorite Accessory

claims.claim: Wandrd, manyetik kamera kayışı sistemini Perşembe günü piyasaya sürdü.

evidence.quote: Wandrd—known for its camera bags—launched its Magnetic Camera Strap system on Thursday.

claims.claim: Torus Links adı verilen dairesel ankrajlar 198 pound'a kadar taşıma kapasitesine sahiptir.

evidence.quote: The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds—so unless you're bench-pressing your camera, they'll do the job.
It features a circular anchor similar to Peak Design, called “Torus Links.” The anchors attach to your camera’s eyelets and are rated to carry up to 198 pounds

claims.claim: Wandrd ürün için iki yıllık garanti sunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: (Wandrd offers a two-year warranty.)

claims.claim: Wandrd, kullanıcıların sistemi mevcut kayışlarında kullanabilmesi için 29 dolara bir DIY kiti satmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Wandrd is selling a DIY kit ($29) that lets you attach its Magnetic CoreLock system to the ends of your preferred strap.

claims.claim: Manyetik kamera kayışı kitinin 30 mm boyutu 69 dolardan satışa sunulmaktadır.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, the strap kit comes in a 30-mm size ($69), a 15-mm “Lite
Otherwise, the strap kit comes in a 30-mm size ($69)

claims.claim: Kayit kitinin 15 mm Lite versiyonu 49 dolardır.

evidence.quote: a 15-mm “Lite
and a wrist strap ($39).
“We're photographers ourselves, so we're constantly ideating, tinkering, thinking of ways that things can be better,” Ryan Cope, Wandrd cofounder, tells WIRED.
